rejectedWebWorkerCandidates.decision: keep as shared parser and fallback oracle
rejectedWebWorkerCandidates.reason: The heavy product import analysis already runs in productImportWorker, contact/inventory/sales row checks already use focused workers, and the remaining generic parseCSV surface has no direct UI caller.
rejectedWebWorkerCandidates.evidence: Move 167 inspection found parseCsvRows used by productImportPlanner inside a Worker and by an unused localDb.parseCSV compatibility helper.

rejectedWebWorkerCandidates.reason: Photo barcode scanning depends on FileReader, Image elements, native BarcodeDetector, and zxing BrowserMultiFormatReader image-element decoding; broad Worker extraction would duplicate the path and lose browser compatibility.
rejectedWebWorkerCandidates.evidence: Move 168 inspection found DOM image loading and browser detector/zxing boundaries rather than a pure CPU loop that can move safely to a Worker.

rejectedWebWorkerCandidates.reason: The modal owns camera permission state, media streams, video refs, requestAnimationFrame scanning, and manual-entry UI. These are DOM and user-permission workflows, not transferable Worker computation.
rejectedWebWorkerCandidates.evidence: Move 168 inspection found getUserMedia, video element, permission watcher, BarcodeDetector, zxing controls, and React state tightly coupled to the UI lifecycle.

rejectedWebWorkerCandidates.decision: keep on main browser scanner path
rejectedWebWorkerCandidates.reason: The Scanbot adapter injects the vendor UI script, checks document camera policy, reads browser permission state, and starts the SDK UI. Those are DOM, camera permission, and third-party browser UI boundaries rather than transferable Worker computation.
rejectedWebWorkerCandidates.evidence: Move 653 inspection found the useful cleanup was a shared typed camera-permission helper used by both Scanbot mode selection and the scanner modal, while broad Worker extraction would duplicate main-thread SDK and document access.

rejectedWebWorkerCandidates.reason: The lightbox filters a small image list, clamps an index, handles keyboard navigation, and renders images/thumbnails. It has no decoding, resizing, or heavy image processing loop to transfer.
rejectedWebWorkerCandidates.evidence: Move 169 inspection found React state/control rendering and event handlers only; image loading remains normal browser rendering.

rejectedWebWorkerCandidates.reason: The helper maps completed import-job types to refresh channels and dispatches sync:update browser events. Moving it to a Worker would add message overhead and lose direct window event dispatch.
rejectedWebWorkerCandidates.evidence: Move 169 inspection found small status/type normalization, Set dedupe, and CustomEvent dispatch only; Move 385 converted the helper to TypeScript but kept the same main-thread event boundary.

rejectedWebWorkerCandidates.reason: Polls import-job state, dedupes a bounded eight-row list, dispatches completion refreshes, and coordinates UI actions; it has no file parsing, media decoding, or CPU-heavy browser loop worth moving to a Worker.
rejectedWebWorkerCandidates.evidence: Move 165 inspection of BackgroundImportTracker.tsx found API orchestration and tiny list transforms only.
